thread:
alexa: Quick thread  feedback on API keys empty / create flows. Noticed two confusing spots: the empty table CTA and the create modal copy around scope.

ben: On empty state - instead of a disabled create button for users without perms, show a contextual CTA: 'Request key creation access' that opens a pre-filled request modal. Helps reduce support tickets.

maya: Yes. Request modal should include estimated SLA for responses like 'team admins usually respond within 48 hours' to set expectations. Also show who will approve (team admin/org owner).

ryan: Create modal copy: current text says 'Choose scope' which is vague. Suggest: 'Key scope (who can use this key)' with radio options: 'Project (recommended)', 'Team', 'Organization'. Add a short line about blast radius.

tess: A11y: when the create modal appears, ensure focus is on the first form field. After creation, focus must move to the 'Download key' button and an aria-live message: 'New key created. Download now 00this will only be shown once.' Also provide a keyboard shortcut hint for download.

alexa: UX microcopy: instead of 'this will only be shown once' use 'you'll only be able to view this key once' per Tess. More active and clearer.

ben: Iconography: permission hints currently use the red warning. Let's switch to a neutral inline info icon for scope notes and reserve red for irreversible actions like permanent deletion.

maya: For revoke, propose 2 modes: soft revoke (10s undo) for user keys and permanent revoke for org keys with an extra confirmation checkbox: 'I understand services may break.' Keep the CTA text explicit: 'Revoke keys' or 'Permanently delete key'.

ryan: Table row density: add a small 'last used' timestamp and a compact service badge (if linked) so users can make informed rotate/revoke decisions without opening the detail panel. On mobile collapse to two lines but keep badges visible.

uxbot: Checklist added to design doc: focus order, aria-live copy, contrast for info icon, explicit CTAs for bulk actions, request-access flow. Link: figma.com/file/abc123 (internal).

alexa: One more: add an inline 'Why scope matters' tooltip near scope selection that opens a tiny explainer overlay (not a full page). Helps new users.

ben: I'll file a small follow-up: make empty state actionable + request-flow, swap icon palette, add focus rule tests.

maya: I'll update mocks and push variations (no-perm empty, request modal, create modal with scope explainer, revoke modes) into #design-review tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
